Ah! This is a crucial point!
"Orders are SIMULTANEOUS: the enemy writes their orders at the same time as you, over the same snapshot of the map you are reading now. Nothing you order this turn is visible to them before it happens."
So if we order a build in Murcia this turn, it will be ready NEXT turn. We cannot send it this turn.
If we order a send from Murcia this turn, we can only send the troops that are ALREADY there and available: 2 archers, 1 knight.

So if we send 2 archers and 1 knight on Turn 15, they arrive on Turn 16 and fight alone. If they lose, they are defeated, and Valencia's garrison might even be reinforced by the enemy!
